source.title: Effectiveness of Empagliflozin vs Dapagliflozin for Kidney Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes

source_integrity_findings.issue: Supplement eTable 1 labels the target-trial research question as cardiovascular effectiveness, while its aim, outcomes, article title, and main study question concern kidney effectiveness. The wording is preserved as a source inconsistency and not used to redefine the study objective.

The Supplement contents list eTable 6 as follow-up information and eTable 7 as incidence, but the actual table pages label eTable 6 as incidence and eTable 7 as follow-up. The main Results text also uses both mappings. Outputs cite the actual table-page labels.

Main Methods and Supplement eTable 1 require CKD confirmatory tests at least 90 days apart, while Figure 1 footnotes describe confirmation 30 to 180 days after the first indication for incident CKD outcomes. The discrepancy is preserved and not silently reconciled.
